_comment: Credential-harvest phish delivered to a user mailbox. The teaching case
for the email deep-dive: every authentication check PASSES and ALIGNS,
because the attacker owns the lookalike domain and configured SPF, DKIM
and DMARC for it correctly. A tool that reads 'dmarc=pass' as 'benign'
clears this message. What gives it away is everything authentication
does not cover: the display name claims a brand the sending domain is
not authorized to send as, replies are routed to a consumer mailbox,
and the link puts the brand in the SUBDOMAIN of a site the attacker
controls, with the recipient's own address in the fragment so the fake
title: Credential-harvest link delivered to user mailbox
